title: A rotation making all coordinate projections of a purely unrectifiable set null (Simon 3, Structure Theorem 3.6, as used in 8.1)
statement: For P, m ∈ ℕ and n := m + 1, let A ⊆ ℝ^P be purely n-unrectifiable (every countably n-rectifiable subset of A has Hⁿ-measure 0) and Hⁿ-σ-finite (A ⊆ ⋃_{j∈ℕ} S_j with Hⁿ(S_j) < ∞ for all j). Then there is a linear isometry Q of ℝ^P such that Lⁿ(p_α(Q(A))) = 0 for every α ∈ I(n,P), where p_α(x) = (x^{α(1)}, …, x^{α(n)}) and Lⁿ is Lebesgue measure on ℝⁿ.
lean_statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (A : Set (Eucl P)), Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter03.PurelyUnrectifiable (m + 1) A → (∃ S : ℕ → Set (Eucl P), A ⊆ ⋃ j, S j ∧ ∀ j, (μHE[m + 1] : Measure (Eucl P)) (S j) < ∞) → ∃ Q : Eucl P ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] Eucl P, ∀ α : SimonMultiIndex (m + 1) P, (volume : Measure (Eucl (m + 1))) ((fun x : Eucl P => (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i : Fin (m + 1) => Q x (α i)) : Eucl (m + 1))) '' A) = 0
